spec.description: Whether cert-converter's outputs match its inputs, when each certificate was last converted, and what needs your attention. It reads the metrics page METRICS_LISTEN_ADDR serves, and the attention tiles need the rules from alerts/promql.yaml loaded.

spec.title: cert-converter scrape
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterDown alert fires: no scrape of cert-converter has succeeded for 5 minutes. It also shows when no cert-converter target exists at all, because the alert for a missing target carries no instance. Check the container's state and that your scraper reaches METRICS_LISTEN_ADDR. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.expr: 0 * max((ALERTS{alertname="CertConverterDown", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance"} or ALERTS{alertname="CertConverterDown", alertstate="firing", instance=""}))

spec.title: Conversions
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterConversionFailed alert fires: the latest scan could not convert a source, so its output is stale or missing and the container is unhealthy. The container log names the file. Check file ownership, the PFX password and the chain. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Output names
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterOutputNameCollision alert fires: two inputs map to one flat output name, so neither converts and the container is unhealthy. Rename one input folder, or set OUTPUT_LAYOUT=mirror. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Output writes
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterOutputWriteRefused alert fires: cert-converter could not safely replace an output, so a consumer can keep reading a stale file. Check the ownership and permissions of /output. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Last scan
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterScanAborted alert fires: the latest scan ended early, usually because /input or /output could not be opened, and the container is unhealthy. Check both mounts. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Input tree
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterInputTreeTooLarge alert fires: the latest scan stopped at MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES, so every source past that point is unconverted. Keep only certificates under /input, or raise MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES and the memory limit together. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Change detection
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterChangeDetectionDegraded alert fires: no file watch could be set up, so a renewed certificate waits for the next rescan. Exhausted inotify instances on the host are the usual cause. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Input paths
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterInputPathUnreachable alert fires: the latest scan could not read an /input path or resolve a symlink, so its certificates were skipped. Fix the permissions, and mount the certificate folder instead of a symlink to it. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Certificate sources
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterNoCertificateSources alert fires: the latest full scan found no certificate and key pair and no PFX or P12 bundle, so nothing is produced. Check the /input mount and the file names. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Exclusions
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterEverySourceExcluded alert fires: INPUT_EXCLUDE_PATHS covers every source found, so the scan converted nothing. Narrow the exclusion list. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Temporary files
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterOutputCleanupDegraded alert fires: leftover temporary files under /output, each holding a private key, cannot be removed. Check the ownership and permissions of /output. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Orphan removal
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterOrphanRemovalDisabled alert fires: the scan could not prove any output orphaned, so OUTPUT_LIFECYCLE=sync removed nothing. The container log names the action to take. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Previous layout
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterPreviousLayoutRetained alert fires: sync kept files laid out for another OUTPUT_LAYOUT, because OUTPUT_LAYOUT is unset. Move consumers to the current paths, then set OUTPUT_LAYOUT. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Scans
spec.description: Shows while the CertConverterScanStalled alert fires: no scan finished healthy by its deadline. Failing scans cross it too, so check the other tiles first. Otherwise the watch loop is likely stuck, so restart the container. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Last scan ended
spec.description: When the latest scan ended, healthy or not. A file watch scans on every change, and a rescan runs every FALLBACK_SCAN_HOURS, 6 hours by default. No value means no scan has ended since the start, or cert-converter was not scraped.

spec.title: Last healthy scan
spec.description: When the latest healthy scan ended, meaning it read /input with no conversion failure and no output name collision. A stop at MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES or an unreadable or excluded source still counts as healthy, and Outputs match inputs or the table shows it. A time older than Last scan ended means the scans since then were unhealthy. No value means no healthy scan since the start.

spec.title: Outputs removed
spec.description: Outputs OUTPUT_LIFECYCLE=sync removed because their source is gone, in each time slot, with the total for the selected range in the legend. A bar you did not expect means a source vanished from /input. A slot near a container restart, a failed scrape or a scrape outage can show fewer or more than happened. Other lifecycle settings never remove an output, so this stays at 0.

spec.expr: round(sum by (instance) (((cert_converter_removed_artifacts_total{instance="$instance"} - cert_converter_removed_artifacts_total{instance="$instance"} offset $__interval) unless on (instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{instance="$instance"} != process_start_time_seconds{instance="$instance"} offset $__interval) or (process_start_time_seconds{instance="$instance"} > time() - ${__interval_ms} / 1000))) or (cert_converter_removed_artifacts_total{instance="$instance"} and on (instance) ((process_start_time_seconds{instance="$instance"} != process_start_time_seconds{instance="$instance"} offset $__interval) or (process_start_time_seconds{instance="$instance"} > time() - ${__interval_ms} / 1000))) or (cert_converter_removed_artifacts_total{instance="$instance"} - min_over_time(cert_converter_removed_artifacts_total{instance="$instance"}[$__interval]))))

spec.title: Outputs match inputs
spec.description: Yes when the latest scan left every output matching its input, otherwise No with the most urgent reason, and the table and the attention tiles show the rest. A red No means an aborted scan, a failed conversion or a name collision, which make the container unhealthy, and a yellow No leaves health unchanged. No scan yet means no scan has ended since the start, or cert-converter was not scraped. OUTPUT_LIFECYCLE=keep never compares /output with /input, so this tile cannot see an output whose input is gone.

spec.expr: max((cert_converter_last_scan_outcome{instance="$instance", outcome="aborted"} == bool 1) * 13 or (cert_converter_last_scan_sources{instance="$instance", outcome="failed"} > bool 0) * 12 or (cert_converter_last_scan_sources{instance="$instance", outcome="collided"} > bool 0) * 11 or (cert_converter_last_scan_sources{instance="$instance", outcome="unwritable"} > bool 0) * 10 or (cert_converter_last_scan_outcome{instance="$instance", outcome="budget_stopped"} == bool 1) * 9 or (cert_converter_last_scan_sources{instance="$instance", outcome=~"unreadable|unresolved|vanished"} > bool 0) * 8 or (cert_converter_condition{instance="$instance", condition="no_sources"} == bool 1) * 7 or (cert_converter_condition{instance="$instance", condition="all_excluded"} == bool 1) * 6 or (cert_converter_last_scan_sources{instance="$instance", outcome="orphan"} > bool 0) * 5 or (cert_converter_condition{instance="$instance", condition="orphan_removal_disabled"} == bool 1) * 4 or (cert_converter_last_scan_unmatched_outputs{instance="$instance"} > bool 0) * 3 or (cert_converter_condition{instance="$instance", condition="previous_layout_retained"} == bool 1) * 2 or (cert_converter_last_scan_sources{instance="$instance", outcome="ignored"} > bool 0) * 1) and on () (cert_converter_last_scan_timestamp_seconds{instance="$instance"} > 0)

spec.title: Last conversion
spec.description: When cert-converter last wrote an output for any certificate. After a restart this is the newest output file's time. No conversion yet means no certificate has an output. Not scraped means cert-converter was not scraped, or its first scan has not ended.

spec.title: Certificates
spec.description: Certificate sources cert-converter knows under /input, excluded ones included. The table below has one row for each. Not scraped means cert-converter was not scraped, or its first scan has not ended.

spec.title: Errors now
spec.description: Certificates in a problem state in the table below. Unhealthy counts those that failed to convert or share an output name, red from 1, and Warnings counts write refused, unreadable, vanished during scan and key missing, yellow from 1, both green at 0. A problem with the scan itself rather than one certificate shows in Outputs match inputs. Not scraped means cert-converter was not scraped, or its first scan has not ended.

spec.title: Next scan
spec.description: When cert-converter next rechecks every certificate on its own, every FALLBACK_SCAN_HOURS and at least daily. A changed file under /input brings a scan sooner. A time in the past means the scan is running now or the watch loop is stuck, which the Scans attention tile shows once CertConverterScanStalled fires. Not scraped means cert-converter was not scraped.

spec.title: Each certificate
spec.description: Each certificate source under /input, problems first, with what the latest scan that reached it did and when it was last converted. The path is relative to /input. Failed to convert and Name collision show in red, the other problems in yellow. Never means it has no output, and No certificates means none was found, cert-converter was not scraped, or its first scan has not ended.

spec.title: Converted in ${span} ${spanunit}
spec.description: Certificates whose latest conversion falls inside the selected range. A certificate converted twice counts once, and one converted and then removed does not count. Not scraped means cert-converter was not scraped, or its first scan has not ended.

spec.title: Cert Converter

spec.label: cert-converter
spec.description: The cert-converter to show, by its scrape instance. Each container converts its own /input.

spec.name: attention

spec.name: spanread
spec.label: Range length source
spec.description: Reads the length of the time range for span, spanunit and spanthe, all their words in one answer.

spec.query: query_result(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (u) ("n", label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 86400), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 172800), "u", "days", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 3600), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 7200), "u", "hours", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 60)) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 120), "u", "minutes", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s)), "u", "seconds", "", "")), "n", "$1 : ", "n", "(.+)"), "u", "$1 : ", "u", "(.+)"))

spec.definition: query_result(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (u) ("n", label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 86400), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 172800), "u", "days", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 3600), 0.1) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 7200), "u", "hours", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s / 60)) and on () (vector($__range_s) >= 120), "u", "minutes", "", "") or on () label_replace(round(vector($__range_s)), "u", "seconds", "", "")), "n", "$1 : ", "n", "(.+)"), "u", "$1 : ", "u", "(.+)"))

spec.name: span
spec.label: Range length
spec.description: The number of the dashboard time range's length, such as "30" in "30 days", from spanread. It reads "the" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: spanunit
spec.label: Range unit
spec.description: The unit of the dashboard time range's length, such as "days" in "30 days", from spanread. It reads "range" until spanread has read a length.

spec.name: spanthe
spec.label: Range length with its article
spec.description: The word "the" and the number of the dashboard time range's length, such as "the 30" in "the 30 days", from spanread. It reads "the" until spanread has read a length.
